# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from ue.py's argument parser. Don't edit by hand: change the help
     text in ue.py, then run `python scripts/gen_docs.py`. -->

Every command of `ue.py` with its arguments. `ue.py -h` and `ue.py <command> -h` print the same help. Below,
`ue.py` means `python <toolkit folder>/ue.py` (or `ue` when installed with pipx).

```text
ue.py - drive Unreal Engine for any project from the command line (no manual steps).

  python <toolkit folder>/ue.py [--project PATH] <command> [options]
  The project is the nearest *.uproject above the current folder unless --project is given.

Build & code   build, genproject, livecoding, test, package
Editor         editor start|stop|restart|status, kill, windows, screenshot
In-editor      py (Python in the live editor or --headless; scenarios with `yield` waits), wait, exec, pie, save
Input          press KEY [--hold s], mouse DX DY [--for s] (Enhanced Input forcing: triggers and modifiers run)
Performance    perf run [LABEL] [--exec CMD], perf compare A B, perf list (CSV profiler medians of the running game)
State          snapshot save|restore|status (pie start --protect, editor start --no-throttle restore themselves)
Diagnostics    info, log, crash, bridge install|uninstall|status
Review         bpdump (every Blueprint as readable text: variables, defaults, widget tree, event flows)
Blueprints     bp graphs|graph|compile (node ids and links for editing with `bpedit` in `ue.py py`)
VFX            vfx install|status|presets|create|preview|describe|place|modules (Niagara via the UETKVfx plugin)
Render         render view|pie|actor|asset|widget (offscreen PNGs via the UETKEditor plugin)
Plugins        plugins install|status (the toolkit's C++ editor plugins, copied into the project and built with it)
Multiplayer    net start|status|stop|logs|run (server + clients as game processes; --instance NAME targets one)
Content        mat, input, import, ui (materials, Enhanced Input, importing, UMG: specs in, assets out)
Checks         validate (Data Validation, Blueprint compiles, broken references, redirectors, textures, map check;
               exit code 1 on errors, for commit hooks and CI)
```

## Options for every command

```text
ue.py [--version] [--project PROJECT] [--instance INSTANCE] COMMAND ...
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--version` | show program's version number and exit |
| `-p`, `--project` PROJECT | .uproject file or its folder (default: found from the current folder) |
| `-i`, `--instance` INSTANCE | talk to a game process started by `ue.py net` (server, client1, ...) instead of the editor: py, exec, wait, render, log |

## Commands

- [`info`](#info): project, engine, editor and bridge status
- [`build`](#build): compile with UnrealBuildTool
- [`genproject`](#genproject): regenerate Visual Studio project files
- [`livecoding`](#livecoding): Live Coding compile in the running editor (.cpp-only changes)
- [`test`](#test): run automation tests headless
- [`package`](#package): BuildCookRun a Win64 game build
- [`editor`](#editor): start/stop/restart/wait/status of the editor
- [`kill`](#kill): force-kill every Unreal process of this project
- [`py`](#py): run Python in the editor (ueh helpers pre-imported); a top-level `yield` makes it a scenario that waits for the game (yield ueh.wait(5) / ueh.until(...))
- [`bpdump`](#bpdump): export every Blueprint (and data asset) and condense it to readable text for review: variables, overridden defaults, widget tree, event flows
- [`render`](#render): offscreen PNG of a camera view, PIE camera, actor, asset or UMG widget (UETKEditor plugin; the editor needn't be in front and nothing changes)
- [`net`](#net): multiplayer session as separate game processes (listen/dedicated server + clients), each with its own bridge: `ue.py --instance client1 py ...`
- [`perf`](#perf): frame times of the running game (PIE or --instance) from the CSV profiler: run [LABEL], compare A B, list
- [`press`](#press): press a key in the running game through Enhanced Input's mappings (Hold/Tap triggers and modifiers run; the OS keyboard isn't touched)
- [`mouse`](#mouse): move the mouse in the running game: (dx, dy) per frame through the mappings
- [`bp`](#bp): Blueprint graphs for editing (UETKEditor plugin): graphs, a graph's nodes with ids and links, compile with the compiler's messages; edit with `bpedit` in `ue.py py`
- [`plugins`](#plugins): the toolkit's editor plugins (UETKEditor, UETKVfx): install = copy them into Plugins/ (then build), status = installed/built/loaded
- [`vfx`](#vfx): Niagara VFX: install the UETKVfx plugin, build systems from presets or JSON specs, preview them offscreen as a PNG contact sheet, describe a system's stack
- [`mat`](#mat): materials: build one from a JSON spec of expressions, read one back as that spec, make instances, list parameters, compile errors, previews (editor/mat.py)
- [`input`](#input): Enhanced Input: read every mapping context and action as a spec, build them from one, map/unmap keys, put contexts on Blueprints or the running player (editor/inputs.py)
- [`import`](#import): import meshes, animations, textures and sounds (files or whole folders) with presets; reimport the ones whose source changed (editor/importer.py)
- [`ui`](#ui): UMG in the running game (PIE or --instance): the widgets on screen, click, type, set values, read text, wait for a widget; and Widget Blueprints from a spec (editor/ui.py)
- [`validate`](#validate): check the project: Data Validation, Blueprint compile errors, broken references, redirectors, texture sizes, map check (also unused assets and naming, opt-in); exit code 1 on errors (editor/validate.py)
- [`exec`](#exec): run a console command in the editor (or PIE with --pie)
- [`wait`](#wait): block until a Python condition is true in the editor, or N s of game time pass
- [`snapshot`](#snapshot): copy files/folders away and put them back exactly (save games, configs)
- [`save`](#save): save the given assets, or every dirty package
- [`pie`](#pie): Play-In-Editor control
- [`log`](#log): show the active editor log
- [`crash`](#crash): summarize the newest crash report
- [`windows`](#windows): list windows of this project's Unreal processes
- [`screenshot`](#screenshot): capture the editor window to PNG
- [`bridge`](#bridge): status of the in-editor bridge; install = also load it in self-launched editors

### info

project, engine, editor and bridge status

```text
ue.py info
```

### build

compile with UnrealBuildTool

```text
ue.py build [--target TARGET] [--config CONFIG] [--platform PLATFORM] [--clean] [--restart] [--save] [--discard] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--target` TARGET | editor \| game \| &lt;TargetName&gt; (default: editor) |
| `--config` CONFIG | Debug \| DebugGame \| Development \| Shipping Default: `Development`. |
| `--platform` PLATFORM | Default: `Win64`. |
| `--clean` | clean before building |
| `--restart` | close the running editor, build, reopen it on the same level |
| `--save` | with --restart: save unsaved assets first |
| `--discard` | with --restart: drop unsaved changes |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | stream full UBT output |

### genproject

regenerate Visual Studio project files

```text
ue.py genproject [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  |

### livecoding

Live Coding compile in the running editor (.cpp-only changes)

```text
ue.py livecoding [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `600`. |

### test

run automation tests headless

```text
ue.py test [filter] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `filter` | test path prefix(es), '+'-separated (default: all project tests) |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `1800`. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  |

### package

BuildCookRun a Win64 game build

```text
ue.py package [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--config` CONFIG | Default: `Development`. |
| `--out` OUT | archive directory (default Saved/UnrealToolkit/Packaged/&lt;config&gt;) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  |

### editor

start/stop/restart/wait/status of the editor

```text
ue.py editor {start,stop,restart,wait,status} [--map MAP] [--no-build] [--no-wait] [--no-throttle] [--save] [--discard] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | wait = block until a launching editor is usable One of: `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `wait`, `status`. |
| `--map` MAP | level to open, e.g. /Game/Warehouse/Levels/Showcase |
| `--no-build` | skip the pre-launch build |
| `--no-wait` | return right after launching |
| `--no-throttle` | start/restart: keep full speed when the editor is in the background (restored on stop) |
| `--save` | stop: save unsaved assets first |
| `--discard` | stop: force-close, dropping unsaved changes |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `900`. |

### kill

force-kill every Unreal process of this project

```text
ue.py kill
```

### py

run Python in the editor (ueh helpers pre-imported); a top-level `yield` makes it a scenario that waits for the game (yield ueh.wait(5) / ueh.until(...))

```text
ue.py py [code] [--file FILE] [--headless] [--force] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--log LOG] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `code` | code, or '-' for stdin |
| `-f`, `--file` FILE | run a .py file |
| `--headless` | run in a fresh UnrealEditor-Cmd instead of the live editor |
| `--force` | allow --headless while the editor is running |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `300`. |
| `--log` LOG | which log lines to show One of: `problems`, `errors`, `all`, `none`. |
| `--json` | print the raw response |

### bpdump

export every Blueprint (and data asset) and condense it to readable text for review: variables, overridden defaults, widget tree, event flows

```text
ue.py bpdump [paths ...] [--out OUT] [--skip SKIP [SKIP ...]] [--headless] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `paths` | content roots to scan (default: /Game) |
| `--out` OUT | output folder (default: Saved/UnrealToolkit/bpdump); writes raw/ and txt/ inside |
| `--skip` SKIP | more package-path prefixes to leave out (template folders are skipped by default: Mannequins, LevelPrototyping, StarterContent) |
| `--headless` | export in a fresh UnrealEditor-Cmd even if the editor runs |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `1800`. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | print the index of converted assets |

### render

offscreen PNG of a camera view, PIE camera, actor, asset or UMG widget (UETKEditor plugin; the editor needn't be in front and nothing changes)

```text
ue.py render {view,pie,actor,asset,widget} [target] [--at AT] [--look LOOK] [--rot ROT] [--size SIZE] [--fov FOV] [--exposure EXPOSURE] [--yaws YAWS] [--pitch PITCH] [--zoom ZOOM] [--columns COLUMNS] [--isolate] [--no-floor] [--no-env] [--pie] [--player PLAYER] [--post POST] [--mesh MESH] [--out OUT] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `kind` | view = the open level from the viewport camera or --at/--look; pie = a player's camera; actor = a level actor from several angles; asset = mesh/material/Blueprint/texture/widget in a preview scene; widget = a UMG widget at --size One of: `view`, `pie`, `actor`, `asset`, `widget`. |
| `target` | actor label, asset path, or widget Blueprint path / class |
| `--at` AT | view: camera location x,y,z (default: the viewport camera) |
| `--look` LOOK | view: point the camera at x,y,z |
| `--rot` ROT | view: camera rotation pitch,yaw,roll |
| `--size` SIZE | WxH pixels per frame (view 1600x900, actor/asset 800x600, widget 1920x1080) |
| `--fov` FOV | horizontal field of view |
| `--exposure` EXPOSURE | fixed exposure compensation in stops (default: meter to mid-gray) |
| `--yaws` YAWS | actor/asset: camera yaws, e.g. 0,90,180,270 (relative to the subject's facing) |
| `--pitch` PITCH | actor/asset: camera pitch (default -20) |
| `--zoom` ZOOM | actor/asset: &gt;1 moves closer than the fit |
| `--columns` COLUMNS | frames per row |
| `--isolate` | actor: draw only the actor |
| `--no-floor` | asset: hide the preview floor |
| `--no-env` | asset: hide the preview sky |
| `--pie` | widget: the live instance on screen in PIE |
| `--player` PLAYER | pie: player index (default 0) |
| `--post` POST | post-process material path(s), comma-separated, applied to the render |
| `--mesh` MESH | asset: the static mesh a surface material is drawn on (default a sphere) |
| `--out` OUT | PNG path (default Saved/UnrealToolkit/renders/&lt;name&gt;.png) |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `600`. |

### net

multiplayer session as separate game processes (listen/dedicated server + clients), each with its own bridge: `ue.py --instance client1 py ...`

```text
ue.py net {start,status,stop,logs,run} [script] [--map MAP] [--clients CLIENTS] [--dedicated] [--render RENDER] [--port PORT] [--args ARGS] [--steam] [--protect] [--grep GREP] [--errors] [--tail TAIL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | run = execute a test script (system Python) with `net` in scope (see uetk/net.py) One of: `start`, `status`, `stop`, `logs`, `run`. |
| `script` | run: the script |
| `--map` MAP | start: map (default: the project's GameDefaultMap) |
| `--clients` CLIENTS | start: number of clients (default 1) |
| `--dedicated` | start: dedicated server instead of a listen server |
| `--render` RENDER | start: instances that open a window instead of -nullrhi, e.g. client1 |
| `--port` PORT | Default: `7777`. |
| `--args` ARGS | start: extra command-line arguments for every process |
| `--steam` | start: leave Steam on (default -nosteam: LAN/IP sessions) |
| `--protect` | start: snapshot Saved/SaveGames; stop restores it |
| `--grep` GREP | logs: regex filter |
| `--errors` | logs: warnings and errors only |
| `--tail` TAIL | logs: last N merged lines (0 = all) Default: `200`. |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `300`. |

### perf

frame times of the running game (PIE or --instance) from the CSV profiler: run [LABEL], compare A B, list

```text
ue.py perf {run,compare,list} [labels ...] [--seconds SECONDS] [--settle SETTLE] [--exec EXEC] [--stats STATS [STATS ...]]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `run`, `compare`, `list`. |
| `labels` | run: a label for the saved summary; compare: two labels |
| `--seconds` SECONDS | run: seconds of game time to profile (default 5) |
| `--settle` SETTLE | run: seconds to wait after the --exec commands first Default: `2.0`. |
| `--exec` EXEC | run: console command before measuring (repeatable), e.g. 'r.ScreenPercentage 75'. Cvars stay set until changed back Repeatable. |
| `--stats` STATS | run: more CSV columns to report (substring match), e.g. Physics Net |

### press

press a key in the running game through Enhanced Input's mappings (Hold/Tap triggers and modifiers run; the OS keyboard isn't touched)

```text
ue.py press key [--hold HOLD] [--value VALUE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `key` | key name: E, R, SpaceBar, LeftShift, LeftMouseButton, Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom... |
| `--hold` HOLD | seconds of game time to hold it (default 0.08 = a tap) |
| `--value` VALUE | axis value instead of pressed, e.g. 0.5 or 'X=1 Y=0' |

### mouse

move the mouse in the running game: (dx, dy) per frame through the mappings

```text
ue.py mouse dx dy [--for SECONDS]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `dx` |  |
| `dy` |  |
| `--for` SECONDS | seconds of game time (default 0.25) |

### bp

Blueprint graphs for editing (UETKEditor plugin): graphs, a graph's nodes with ids and links, compile with the compiler's messages; edit with `bpedit` in `ue.py py`

```text
ue.py bp {graphs,graph,compile} path [graph] [--json] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `graphs`, `graph`, `compile`. |
| `path` | Blueprint path, e.g. /Game/BP_Door |
| `graph` | graph: graph name (default: the event graph) |
| `--json` | graph: raw JSON |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `300`. |

### plugins

the toolkit's editor plugins (UETKEditor, UETKVfx): install = copy them into Plugins/ (then build), status = installed/built/loaded

```text
ue.py plugins {install,status} [names ...]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `install`, `status`. |
| `names` | install: only these (dependencies come along); default all |

### vfx

Niagara VFX: install the UETKVfx plugin, build systems from presets or JSON specs, preview them offscreen as a PNG contact sheet, describe a system's stack

```text
ue.py vfx {install,status,presets,create,preview,describe,place,modules} [target] [--preset PRESET] [--set KEY=VALUE [KEY=VALUE ...]] [--spec SPEC] [--preview] [--times TIMES] [--out OUT] [--size SIZE] [--columns COLUMNS] [--yaw YAW] [--pitch PITCH] [--distance DISTANCE] [--exposure EXPOSURE] [--zoom ZOOM] [--background BACKGROUND] [--env] [--floor] [--json] [--hidden] [--at AT] [--label LABEL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | install = copy the plugin into Plugins/ (then build); create = preset/spec -&gt; system; preview = PNG of the system at several ages; modules = list module scripts (TARGET filters) One of: `install`, `status`, `presets`, `create`, `preview`, `describe`, `place`, `modules`. |
| `target` | system path, e.g. /Game/VFX/NS_Fire (modules: a name filter) |
| `--preset` PRESET | create: preset name (`ue.py vfx presets`) |
| `--set` KEY=VALUE | create: preset parameters, e.g. color=[1,0.4,0.1] scale=2 |
| `--spec` SPEC | create: JSON spec file (format in editor/vfx.py) |
| `--preview` | create: also render a preview |
| `--times` TIMES | preview: comma-separated ages in seconds (default 0.1,0.4,0.8,1.5) |
| `--out` OUT | preview: PNG path (default Saved/UnrealToolkit/vfx/&lt;name&gt;.png) |
| `--size` SIZE | preview: pixels per frame (default 320) |
| `--columns` COLUMNS | preview: frames per row |
| `--yaw` YAW | preview: camera yaw (0 = looking along +X) |
| `--pitch` PITCH | preview: camera pitch (default -15) |
| `--distance` DISTANCE | preview: camera distance (default: fit the bounds) |
| `--exposure` EXPOSURE | preview: exposure bias in stops |
| `--zoom` ZOOM | preview: &gt;1 moves closer than the auto-fit (which covers every time) |
| `--background` BACKGROUND | preview: 'black' or r,g,b linear (default: gray behind smoke-like materials) |
| `--env` | preview: show the preview sky instead of black |
| `--floor` | preview: show the preview floor |
| `--json` | describe: raw JSON |
| `--hidden` | describe: include unset/hidden inputs |
| `--at` AT | place: x,y,z in the open level |
| `--label` LABEL | place: actor label |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `900`. |

### mat

materials: build one from a JSON spec of expressions, read one back as that spec, make instances, list parameters, compile errors, previews (editor/mat.py)

```text
ue.py mat {create,instance,describe,params,compile,preview,nodes} [target] [--spec SPEC] [--parent PARENT] [--set NAME=VALUE [NAME=VALUE ...]] [--reset] [--no-save] [--preview] [--mesh MESH] [--size SIZE] [--yaws YAWS] [--pitch PITCH] [--zoom ZOOM] [--exposure EXPOSURE] [--out OUT] [--json] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | create = spec -&gt; material or material function (rebuilds in place); instance = create/update a material instance; describe = the material as spec text; nodes = expression classes and their pins (TARGET filters) One of: `create`, `instance`, `describe`, `params`, `compile`, `preview`, `nodes`. |
| `target` | asset path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Rock (nodes: a name filter) |
| `--spec` SPEC | create: JSON spec file, or - for stdin (format: editor/mat.py) |
| `--parent` PARENT | instance: parent material or instance |
| `--set` NAME=VALUE | instance: parameter values, e.g. Roughness=0.3 "Tint=[1,0,0]" Albedo=/Game/T_X UseDetail=false |
| `--reset` | instance: clear every override first |
| `--no-save` | create/instance: don't save the asset |
| `--preview` | create/instance: also render a preview |
| `--mesh` MESH | preview: sphere (default), plane, cube, cylinder, cone or a static mesh path |
| `--size` SIZE | preview: WxH pixels per frame |
| `--yaws` YAWS | preview: camera yaws, e.g. 0,90 |
| `--pitch` PITCH | preview: camera pitch |
| `--zoom` ZOOM | preview: &gt;1 moves closer |
| `--exposure` EXPOSURE | preview: fixed exposure in stops |
| `--out` OUT | preview: PNG path |
| `--json` | describe: the spec as JSON instead of text |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `900`. |

### input

Enhanced Input: read every mapping context and action as a spec, build them from one, map/unmap keys, put contexts on Blueprints or the running player (editor/inputs.py)

```text
ue.py input {dump,create,map,unmap,use,keys,active,add,remove} [args ...] [--spec SPEC] [--trigger TRIGGER] [--modifier MODIFIER] [--action UNMAP_ACTION] [--key KEY] [--prop PROP] [--remove] [--priority PRIORITY] [--player PLAYER] [--root ROOT] [--json] [--no-save] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | dump [PATH] = the project's input (or one context/action) as spec text; create --spec; map CONTEXT ACTION KEY; unmap CONTEXT --action/--key; use BLUEPRINT CONTEXT = add it to the Blueprint's default contexts; keys [FILTER]; active/add/remove CONTEXT = the running game One of: `dump`, `create`, `map`, `unmap`, `use`, `keys`, `active`, `add`, `remove`. |
| `args` | positional arguments of the action (see above) |
| `--spec` SPEC | create: JSON spec file, or - for stdin (format: editor/inputs.py) |
| `--trigger` TRIGGER | map: a trigger, repeatable: hold, or {"hold": {"hold_time_threshold": 0.5}} as JSON Repeatable. |
| `--modifier` MODIFIER | map: a modifier, repeatable: negate, swizzle, dead_zone... Repeatable. |
| `--action` UNMAP_ACTION | unmap: only this action's mappings |
| `--key` KEY | unmap: only this key's mappings |
| `--prop` PROP | use: the Blueprint property, when it has several context properties |
| `--remove` | use: take the context out of the Blueprint instead |
| `--priority` PRIORITY | add: context priority Default: `0`. |
| `--player` PLAYER | active/add/remove: local player index Default: `0`. |
| `--root` ROOT | dump: only assets under this folder Default: `/Game`. |
| `--json` | dump: the spec as JSON instead of text |
| `--no-save` | create/map/unmap/use: don't save |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `300`. |

### import

import meshes, animations, textures and sounds (files or whole folders) with presets; reimport the ones whose source changed (editor/importer.py)

```text
ue.py import [paths ...] [--to TO] [--kind KIND] [--skeleton SKELETON] [--texture TEXTURE] [--name NAME] [--set KEY=VALUE [KEY=VALUE ...]] [--rule GLOB:KEY=VALUE,...] [--flat] [--reimport] [--all] [--status] [--headless] [--no-save] [--json] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `paths` | files and folders to import (folders recursively); with --reimport or --status: an asset or content folder (default /Game) |
| `--to` TO | destination content folder, e.g. /Game/Props (subfolders are mirrored) |
| `--kind` KIND | what the mesh files are (default: from each file's content and name) One of: `static`, `skeletal`, `animation`. |
| `--skeleton` SKELETON | skeletal meshes: share this skeleton; animations: the skeleton to use (default: the skeletal mesh imported in the same run) |
| `--texture` TEXTURE | texture preset for every texture: color, normal, masks, grayscale, linear, hdr, ui (default: from each name's suffix) |
| `--name` NAME | asset name (one file) |
| `--set` KEY=VALUE | options: materials=false collision=box lod_group=SmallProp scale=100 looping=true sound_class=/Game/... (see editor/importer.py) |
| `--rule` GLOB:KEY=VALUE,... | options for matching file names, repeatable: "*_UI_*.png:texture=ui" Repeatable. |
| `--flat` | don't mirror the source folders' subfolders |
| `--reimport` | reimport assets whose source file changed (--all: every one) |
| `--all` | --reimport: unchanged ones too |
| `--status` | list imported assets, their source files and whether they changed |
| `--headless` | import headless even when an editor is running |
| `--no-save` | don't save the imported assets |
| `--json` | the raw records instead of the summary |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `1800`. |

### ui

UMG in the running game (PIE or --instance): the widgets on screen, click, type, set values, read text, wait for a widget; and Widget Blueprints from a spec (editor/ui.py)

```text
ue.py ui {tree,click,type,set,text,wait,open,describe,create} [args ...] [--player PLAYER] [--hidden] [--no-commit] [--gone] [--spec SPEC] [--json] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | tree = the widgets on screen; click TARGET; type TARGET TEXT; set TARGET VALUE; text [TARGET]; wait TARGET [--gone]; open WBP = put one on screen; describe WBP = a Widget Blueprint's designer tree; create WBP --spec One of: `tree`, `click`, `type`, `set`, `text`, `wait`, `open`, `describe`, `create`. |
| `args` | TARGET is a widget's label (its text, ignoring case) or name |
| `--player` PLAYER | only this local player's widgets |
| `--hidden` | tree: include collapsed and hidden widgets |
| `--no-commit` | type: don't commit (no Enter) |
| `--gone` | wait: until nothing matches |
| `--spec` SPEC | create: JSON spec file, or - for stdin |
| `--json` | tree/describe: data instead of text |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `60`. |

### validate

check the project: Data Validation, Blueprint compile errors, broken references, redirectors, texture sizes, map check (also unused assets and naming, opt-in); exit code 1 on errors (editor/validate.py)

```text
ue.py validate [paths ...] [--checks CHECKS] [--skip SKIP] [--maps MAPS [MAPS ...]] [--max-texture-size MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE] [--naming] [--strict] [--fix-redirectors] [--headless] [--json] [--limit LIMIT] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `paths` | content folders to check (default /Game, or roots in .uetk/validate.json) |
| `--checks` CHECKS | comma-separated checks to run instead of the defaults, or all: references, redirectors, textures, naming, unused, blueprints, data, maps |
| `--skip` SKIP | comma-separated checks to leave out |
| `--maps` MAPS | maps for the map check (default: the open level), or all |
| `--max-texture-size` MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE | largest texture side before a warning (default 4096) |
| `--naming` | check name prefixes (BP_, M_, T_...) by asset class |
| `--strict` | warnings fail too (exit code 1) |
| `--fix-redirectors` | fix up the redirectors under the paths instead: resave their referencers and delete them |
| `--headless` | run headless even when an editor is running |
| `--json` | every finding as JSON instead of the text report |
| `--limit` LIMIT | most findings in the text report (default 200) |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `3600`. |

### exec

run a console command in the editor (or PIE with --pie)

```text
ue.py exec command [--pie] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `command` |  |
| `--pie` |  |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `120`. |

### wait

block until a Python condition is true in the editor, or N s of game time pass

```text
ue.py wait [condition] [--game-seconds GAME_SECONDS] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--interval INTERVAL]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `condition` | expression checked every tick, e.g. "ueh.is_pie()" |
| `--game-seconds` GAME_SECONDS | wait this much PIE game time instead |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | give up after this many seconds (exit code 1) Default: `60`. |
| `--interval` INTERVAL | check every N seconds instead of every tick Default: `0`. |

### snapshot

copy files/folders away and put them back exactly (save games, configs)

```text
ue.py snapshot {save,restore,status} [paths ...] [--name NAME]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `save`, `restore`, `status`. |
| `paths` | save: project-relative paths (default Saved/SaveGames) |
| `--name` NAME | snapshot name (default 'protect', the one PIE uses) |

### save

save the given assets, or every dirty package

```text
ue.py save [paths ...]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `paths` |  |

### pie

Play-In-Editor control

```text
ue.py pie {start,stop,status} [--simulate] [--protect [PATH ...]] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `start`, `stop`, `status`. |
| `--simulate` |  |
| `--protect` PATH | start: snapshot these project paths (default Saved/SaveGames); stop puts them back |
| `--timeout` TIMEOUT | Default: `120`. |

### log

show the active editor log

```text
ue.py log [--tail TAIL] [--errors] [--grep GREP] [--file FILE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tail` TAIL | last N lines (0 = all) Default: `60`. |
| `--errors` | only warnings/errors |
| `--grep` GREP | regex filter |
| `--file` FILE | read a specific log file |

### crash

summarize the newest crash report

```text
ue.py crash
```

### windows

list windows of this project's Unreal processes

```text
ue.py windows
```

### screenshot

capture the editor window to PNG

```text
ue.py screenshot [--out OUT] [--all] [--max-width MAX_WIDTH] [--restore]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--out` OUT | output .png path |
| `--all` | capture every visible editor window (dialogs too) |
| `--max-width` MAX_WIDTH | downscale to this width (0 = native) Default: `1600`. |
| `--restore` | un-minimize minimized windows first |

### bridge

status of the in-editor bridge; install = also load it in self-launched editors

```text
ue.py bridge {install,uninstall,status}
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | One of: `install`, `uninstall`, `status`. |
